user.title: Connect to Lumi Whatsapp Add-on
user.description: Enter the internal URL and API Bearer token from your Home Assistant Lumi Whatsapp Add-on (visible in the Add-on Web UI -> Diagnostics tab).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Lumi Whatsapp Add-on API. Ensure the add-on is running and the URL is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API Bearer token. Check the token in the Lumi Whatsapp Add-on Configuration or Diagnostics tab.
error.unknown: Unexpected error communicating with the Lumi Whatsapp Add-on.

abort.already_configured: This Lumi Whatsapp Add-on endpoint is already configured.
